annotations.title: Reschedule or edit a scheduled post

description: Moves a scheduled post that has not gone out yet to a new time, and can change its caption, title, per-network overrides or first comment at the same time. Only after the user agreed. The time is absolute, so the same call twice leaves the same post.

overrides.description: Per network (tiktok, instagram, youtube, facebook, linkedin, threads, reddit, bluesky): a different caption and, on titled networks (YouTube), a different title. Networks left out use caption / title.
